_about: Where each Brands-page logo comes from (verified 2026-10-31). Priority: the brand's own website or the company that owns the brand, then Wikimedia Commons files attributed to the brand owner, then a logo repository only where no official coloured file exists. Each file was viewed and compared with the brand's logo in the company brochure (public/brochures/HALIMA_TRADING_UPDATED_.pdf, page 4). Processed into public/brands/logos/ by build-brand-logos.mjs (whitespace trimmed; nothing redrawn or recoloured).

o-general.source: Official site: generalww.com (Fujitsu General, global GENERAL brand)

carrier.source: Official Carrier brand portal (linked from carrier.com)

midea.source: Wikimedia Commons, author Midea Group, source global.midea.com. midea.com only shows a white-on-blue version.

gree.source: Wikimedia Commons, author Gree Electric Appliances Inc., source gree.com. Brand colours; global.gree.com shows a black version.

lg.source: Wikimedia Commons: current LG Electronics logo. lg.com only serves a small 196 px JPG.

samsung.source: Wikimedia Commons, author Samsung, source samsung.com brand-identity page. samsung.com's og:image is a square letter mark, not the wordmark.

aftron.source: Brand owner: Al-Futtaim (alfuttaim.com, Aftron brand page). aftron.com does not respond.

clivet.source: Logo repository (worldvectorlogo). clivet.com only publishes the symbol and a white version; the repository file's symbol and wordmark were checked against clivet.com's official logo-white.svg. The older 'feeling cool' tagline is hidden with a clip path (logo shapes untouched), as in Clivet's current logo.

westpoint.source: Wikimedia Commons: 'official Westpoint logo, provided by CFEE' (CFEE is the owner of the WESTPOINT trademark). No official website found.

haier.source: Wikimedia Commons: Haier logo. haier.com/ae only serves white or 93 px versions.

krome.source: Brand owner: EROS Group (eros.ae). Krome is EROS's in-house brand. The only available file is small (154 x 54 px).

toshiba.source: Wikimedia Commons: Toshiba logo. global.toshiba only serves a 161 px GIF.

hisense.source: Official site: Hisense (hisense-india.com; global.hisense.com redirects there)

daewoo.source: Wikimedia Commons, author Daewoo Electronics, source daewoolatam.com

akai.source: Official site: akai.com (AKAI consumer electronics, founded 1929, Tokyo; not Akai Professional). Small file (320 x 63 px).

kenwood.source: Wikimedia Commons, author Kenwood Limited (the kitchen-appliance company, not JVC Kenwood)

khind.source: Official site: khind.com.my. The separate '65th anniversary' badge is trimmed off; the KHIND mark is unchanged.

afra.source: Official site: afra.co (AFRA Store, Afra Electronics, Dubai). This is the brand's current logo; the brochure shows an older design.

celsius.file: Supplied by the client (2026-10-31), screenshot of the brochure logo card
celsius.source: Client-supplied artwork. Cropped to the logo (card border and shadow removed); not redrawn. Only 316 x 144 px was supplied, so a larger original would look sharper.

yorker.file: Supplied by the client (2026-10-31), 276 x 150 px image
yorker.source: Client-supplied artwork. Cropped to the logo; not redrawn. A larger original would look sharper.

general-line.source: Client-supplied artwork. Cropped to the logo; not redrawn. A larger original would look sharper.
